*{{WPLink|Samsung Galaxy Mega}} :Described as a hybrid phone/tablet (''phablet'') :Per '''Wikipedia''', the phone has... ([https://ru.wikipedia.org/wiki/Snapdragon#Snapdragon_400 ''Snapdragon 400'']) :*CPU: [[Qualcomm]] MSM8930AB @1.7GHz ARMv7 (2x Krait 300) :*GPU: Adreno 305, Flash: 16 GB, RAM: 1.5GB @533МГц (LPDDR2) :*a microSDXC slot (up to 64 GB supported) :*a stock OS of '''Android''' 4.2.2 ('''Jelly Bean''')
Per the FCC docs... *The device is approx 87.91 mm wide and 167.06 mm long. *The GPS antenna (Rx only, obviously) is located on right side :at the very top of the unit. *The WLAN antenna is located immediately under the GPS antenna. *A 3G/4G Rx antenna is located on the left side at the very top of the unit. *The 850/1900 GSM/GPRS/EDGE/WCDMA/HSDPA and LTE band 5 :Tx/Rx antenna is located at the bottom left of the unit. *The NFC antenna is integrated into the battery. :SAR testing was performed with the standard battery (B700BE).
===Variants=== *'''GT-I9150''' - 5.8" screen, 1.4GHz CPU, 1.5GB RAM, :8GB built-in storage - no LTE support - no dual SIM support *'''GT-I9152''' - 5.8" screen, 1.4GHz CPU, 1.5GB RAM, :8GB built-in storage - no LTE support - ''dual SIM support'' *'''GT-I9200''' - 6.3" screen, 1.7GHz CPU, 1.5GB RAM, :8GB or 16 GB built-in storage - no LTE support - no dual SIM support *'''GT-I9205''' - 6.3" screen, 1.7GHz CPU, 1.5GB RAM, :8GB or 16 GB built-in storage - ''LTE support'' - no dual SIM support - no FM radio :The AT&T version of the '''GT-I9205''' is known as the '''SGH-i527'''
